title: SCE Experiment 1.3: EC2 Instance Enumeration Detection (Detective Probe) - FIXED
description: This experiment validates the Detective safeguard that detects EC2 instance enumeration attempts via CloudTrail logging and CloudWatch alarming. The experiment creates a controlled environment with target EC2 instances, simulates multiple DescribeInstances API calls from a single principal, and verifies that CloudTrail captures the enumeration pattern and CloudWatch metrics trigger appropriately. This detective control is critical for identifying reconnaissance activity targeting sensitive banking infrastructure. FIXED VERSION: Handles IAM permissions automatically and provides better error diagnostics.
